description: This file defines a PHP class 'ViewPopupview' that extends 'ViewListView' to handle the display and management of popup view configurations within the SuiteCRM module builder. It includes methods for constructing the view, handling AJAX requests, and integrating with Smarty templates for rendering.

classes.name: ViewPopupview
classes.description: A PHP class that manages the display and editing of popup views within the SuiteCRM module builder interface.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new ViewPopupview object, sets module, layout, and package information from the request parameters, and determines if the view is from Module Builder.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Returns the parameters for the module title, including the module name and title context.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Empty method intended to override pre-display behavior if needed.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the popup view, either as a preview or as an AJAX section, using Smarty templates.

methods.name: constructAjax
methods.description: Builds an AjaxCompose object with navigation breadcrumbs specific to module builder or regular modules.

methods.name: constructSmarty
methods.description: Creates and configures a Smarty template instance with all necessary variables for rendering the popup view editor.

methods.name: _constructTitle
methods.description: Generates the title string for the popup view, depending on whether it is from Module Builder or a regular module.
